headline: Google's new Gemini-powered smart speaker is here for $99.99
summary: Google's first smart speaker in six years boasts a new processor, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, and the Gemini AI assistant for smarter home control.
details: Google has officially launched its latest smart speaker, the Google Home Speaker, priced at $99.99. This marks the company's first new speaker release since the Nest Audio in 2020, aiming to bring enhanced AI capabilities and improved hardware to the smart home market.

Under the hood, the new speaker is equipped with a modern Quad-Core A55 2.0 GHz processor featuring a dedicated NPU, 1GB of LPDDR4 RAM, and 4GB of storage. It also receives significant connectivity upgrades with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4, promising more stable and longer-range connections compared to previous models.

Audio performance has also seen a boost, with the new speaker featuring a 2x larger driver and 2.5x stronger bass than the Nest Mini. This upgrade is delivered through a 58 mm full-range driver, aiming to provide a richer sound experience for music and voice interactions.

The standout feature is the integration of Gemini for Home, described as a "radically smarter and more capable voice assistant." Gemini can understand and execute multiple commands simultaneously, simplifying complex routines like adjusting lighting, temperature, and music with a single request.

Users can also access Gemini Live for conversational assistance, though this feature requires a Google Home Premium subscription. Purchasers of the new speaker before September 30, 2026, will receive a complimentary six-month trial of the subscription service.

topic: siri ai in action sparks future excitement
headline_marked: Apple's [[Siri AI]] demo shows future potential for voice assistant
headline: Apple's Siri AI demo shows future potential for voice assistant
summary: A hands-on look at Siri's AI capabilities reveals a significant leap forward, hinting at a more intelligent and responsive voice assistant.
details: Apple's upcoming AI advancements for Siri were recently showcased in a hands-on demo, generating excitement for the future of the voice assistant.
The demonstration highlighted Siri's enhanced ability to understand context and perform more complex tasks, moving beyond its current limitations.
While specific features and release dates remain under wraps, the demo suggests a significant upgrade in natural language processing and task completion capabilities.
This evolution aims to position Siri as a more competitive and capable AI assistant in the rapidly advancing tech landscape.
